question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Exagerate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is **'Exagerate'**.
 
• The correct spelling is **'Exaggerate'.**
 
• It means to represent something as being larger, more important, better, or worse than it actually is. (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर)
 
 
• **Example:** *Don't **exaggerate** your achievements on your resume, be truthful about your skills and experiences.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelt word is **'Exagerate'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of the other words:-

 
 
• Legitimate: To make something legal or acceptable. (वैध)

 
 
• Example: Her passport seemed **legitimate**, but on closer inspection, it was found to have been altered.
 
 
 
• **Propagate:** To spread, promote, or transmit something, such as an idea, belief, or information. (फैलना)
 
 
• Example: Plants **propagate** through seeds or cuttings, creating new individuals.
 
 
 
• **Promulgate:** To make a new law, idea known officially and publicly. (घोषणा करना)
 
 
• Example: The government will **promulgate** new regulations regarding public safety.
